set.body: Deliver one coherent release slice: freeze correlation-distance dispositions, state defensible novelty without speed or priority overclaims, provide a question-first executable newcomer journey with API tiering, and certify every public map-scale path that journey exposes. Acceptance: current APIs and estimands only; nonlinear views remain outside the bilinear-query theorem; real-data parity and uncertainty claims are scoped to recorded evidence; performance gates include oracle parity, warm-up, repeated timings, dimensional regime, and map-level budgets; README, vignette, reference navigation, and tests agree.
set.title: Make effectagram legible, bounded, and honestly novel
